statement: Static triage on changed lines can PASS a diff that detonates the suite one import away. This gate applies the produced diff to a pristine anchor copy and runs the WHOLE suite; empty suite is a refusal, never a pass; the anchor is never mutated. Golden leg: NL issue -> orchestrator diff -> triage PASS -> applygate PASS. Sabotage legs: (1) unused-import edit -> BOTH gates fire (F401 blocks statically; runtime fails too); (2) rename-only diff -> triage PASS but applygate FAIL with the broken module named -- the blind spot this capability exists to close. Both legs measured; artifact byte-identical on rerun.
